description.value: Babylon Cafe is a long-established Middle Eastern restaurant on Denman Street serving shawerma, falafel, wraps, and combination plates made with fresh daily-prepped vegetables, house-made sauces, and marinated meats. The restaurant traces its roots to a beloved hole-in-the-wall on Robson Street that opened in 2004 and built a loyal following entirely by word of mouth. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, and the menu carries strong vegetarian options across both Vancouver locations.
